name: RESTResponseV2
title: RESTResponseV2 - Scoped, Global
summary: The RESTResponseV2 API provides methods that allow you to use the data returned by an outbound REST message in JavaScript code.
overview:
A RESTResponseV2 object is returned by the RESTMessageV2 methods execute() and executeAsync().

You can use this API in scoped applications or within the global scope.

This API runs in the sn_ws namespace.

members.name: getAllHeaders
members.summary: Returns all headers contained in the response, including any duplicate headers.
members.html:
Parameters
Name Type Description
None
Returns
Type Description
List<GlideHTTPHeader> List of headers contained in the response. Each header is represented as a GlideHTTPHeader object which contains the header name and value.

The follow code example shows how to call the REST Table API and then lists out all of the headers found in the response.

var request = new sn_ws.RESTMessageV2();
request.setEndpoint('http://<SN_Instance_host>/api/now/table/incident');
request.setHttpMethod('GET');

request.setBasicAuth('username', 'password');
request.setRequestHeader("Accept", "application/json");
var res = request.execute();
if (res.getStatusCode() != 200) {
  gs.info('Bad Request');
}

var headers = res.getAllHeaders();
for(var i in headers){
  gs.info(headers[i].name + ': ' + headers[i].value);
}

members.name: getBody
members.summary: Gets the content of the REST response body.
members.html:
Use this function when you want to get the request body as text content. Do not use this method when saving the response as a binary attachment. If a RESTMessageV2 object called the saveResponseBodyAsAttachment(...) function, using getBody() on the associated RESTResponseV2 object will cause an error. When saving the response as an attachment, if the outbound REST message fails, call getErrorMessage() on the response to retrieve the body content.

Parameters
Name Type Description
None
Returns
Type Description
String REST response body. 
var sm = new sn_ws.RESTMessageV2("Yahoo Finance","get"); //Might throw exception if message doesn't exist or not visible due to scope.
var response = sm.execute();
var responseBody = response.getBody();

members.name: getCookies
members.summary: Returns all cookies included in the response.
members.html:
Parameters
Name Type Description
None
Returns
Type Description
Object Array of strings representing cookies. Iterate through the array to perform operations on each cookie.

Display individual cookies from the response.

var cookies = response.getCookies();
for (var i = 0; i < cookies.length; i++) {
  gs.info('cookie: ' + cookies.get(i));
}
Output: 
cookie: JSESSIONID=4135AA97A5D12DA22EF614AA2B0CAFD8.node20; Path=/; Secure; HttpOnly
cookie: SABASESSIONID=370152970.36895.0000; path=/

members.name: getErrorCode
members.summary: Gets the numeric error code if there was an error during the REST transaction.
members.html:
This error code is specific to the ServiceNow AI Platform, it is not an HTTP error code. Provide this error code if you require assistance from ServiceNow Customer Support.

Note:
To retrieve the contents of the actual error message, use the getBody() method.
Parameters
Name Type Description
None
Returns
Type Description
Number Numeric error code, such as 1 for socket timeout. 
var sm = new sn_ws.RESTMessageV2("Yahoo Finance","get"); //Might throw exception if message doesn't exist or not visible due to scope.
var response = sm.execute();
var errorCode = response.getErrorCode();

members.name: getHeader
members.summary: Gets the value for a specified header.
members.html:
Parameters
Name Type Description
name String Name of the header that you want the value for, such as Set-Cookie.
Returns
Type Description
String Value of the specified header. 
var sm = new sn_ws.RESTMessageV2("Yahoo Finance","get"); //Might throw exception if message doesn't exist or not visible due to scope.
var response = sm.execute();
var headerVal = response.getHeader("Content-Type");

members.name: getHeaders
members.summary: Gets all headers returned in the REST response and the associated values.
members.html:
Note:
If a header is present more than once in the response, such as a Set-Cookie header, this function returns only the last of the duplicate headers. To return all headers including duplicates, use the getAllHeaders() function.
Parameters
Name Type Description
None
Returns
Type Description
Object Object that maps the name of each header to the associated value. 
var sm = new sn_ws.RESTMessageV2("Yahoo Finance","get"); //Might throw exception if message doesn't exist or not visible due to scope.
var response = sm.execute();
var headers = response.getHeaders();

members.name: getQueryString
members.summary: Gets the fully-resolved query sent to the REST endpoint..
members.html:
This query contains the endpoint URL as well as any values assigned to variables in the REST message. Use this method only with responses to direct requests. This method is not supported for requests sent asynchronously, or requests sent using a MID server.

Parameters
Name Type Description
None
Returns
Type Description
String Fully-resolved query. 
var sm = new sn_ws.RESTMessageV2("Yahoo Finance","get"); //Might throw exception if message doesn't exist or not visible due to scope.
var response = sm.execute();
var queryString = response.getQueryString();

members.name: getResponseAttachmentSysid
members.summary: Gets the sys_id value of the attachment created from the response body content.
members.html:
If the RESTMessageV2 object associated with this response called the saveResponseBodyAsAttachment(...) function, use getResponseAttachmentSysid() to get the sys_id of the created attachment record. Use this function when you want to perform additional operations with the new attachment record.

Parameters
Name Type Description
None
Returns
Type Description
String Sys_id of the new attachment record.

members.name: waitForResponse
members.summary: Set the amount of time the instance waits for a response from the web service provider.
members.html:
This method overrides the property glide.rest.outbound.ecc_response.timeout for this REST response.

Parameters
Name Type Description
timeoutSecs Number The amount of time, in seconds, to wait for this response.
Returns
Type Description
void 
var sm = new sn_ws.RESTMessageV2("Yahoo Finance","get"); //Might throw exception if message doesn't exist or not visible due to scope.
var response = sm.executeAsync();
response.waitForResponse(60);
